Name: (AT) Cats on Cat Trees (Animated)
Author: NoraCharles
Description:
Unfortunately our cats can't actually sit on the new cat trees, but I wanted to make it look like someone is using the cat tree!

Available for both cat tree colors, all 5 vanilla cat breeds, and 2 color palettes: vanilla and a recolor (slightly desaturated & less yellow).

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] -- visit Robin's shop to buy the "Paint Bucket" tool. With the tool selected, click on the Cat Tree or Dark Cat Tree (near the bottom) to see all available textures.

Marnie sells cat trees for 10,000g each (!) but if you use my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22388]Better Furniture Catalogue[/url], you can get them from the Furniture Catalogue.

Thanks to [b]herbivoor[/b] and [b]seitanicbean[/b] for creating [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20749]Universal Recolors[/url]! I used its assets for the recolored cats & cat trees.

Check out the companion mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23002](AT) Dogs in Doghouses[/url]


[b]MY OTHER MODS[/b]

Check out [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/NoraCharles/mods?gameId=1303]my other mods for Stardew Valley[/url], which include maps, animals, crops, furniture, clothing, and more!
All donation points earned by my mods go to [url=https://www.doctorswithoutborders.org/]Doctors Without Borders[/url].
